legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.summary: This policy explains how personal data, including health data, is collected, used, protected and shared in Joprelys Connect.
legal.privacy.scope.title: 1. Purpose and scope
legal.privacy.scope.p1: This policy applies to Joprelys Connect, its professional and patient areas, and the related support, security and administration services.
legal.privacy.scope.p2: It covers professional users, patients, legal representatives, facility administrators and every person whose data is processed through the platform.
legal.privacy.roles.title: 2. Who processes the data?
legal.privacy.roles.p1: The legal role depends on the processing operation concerned. The clinic or healthcare facility generally determines the purposes related to medical care. JOPRELYS SARL provides and secures the platform in accordance with the instructions and responsibilities agreed with the facility.
legal.privacy.roles.i1: For medical records and care activities, the healthcare facility generally acts as controller and JOPRELYS SARL as technical provider or processor.
legal.privacy.roles.i2: For the management of its own accounts, contracts, billing, support, security and legal claims, JOPRELYS SARL may act as controller.
legal.privacy.roles.i3: For certain exchanges between facilities, the allocation of responsibilities must be defined by contract and by the information provided to the patient.
legal.privacy.data.title: 3. Categories of data processed
legal.privacy.data.i1: Identity, photograph, sex, date of birth, contact details, emergency contacts and patient identifiers.
legal.privacy.data.i2: Health data: medical history, allergies, consultations, diagnoses, observations, prescriptions, results, imaging, hospital stays and medical documents.
legal.privacy.data.i3: Administrative data: facility, department, referring professional, appointments, admissions and access requests.
legal.privacy.data.i4: Financial data: invoices, payments, insurance, agreements, cash operations and accounting evidence.
legal.privacy.data.i5: Professional data: identity, position, speciality, permissions, signatures and actions performed.
legal.privacy.data.i6: Technical data: IP address, device, browser, timestamps, sessions, security logs and audit trails.
legal.privacy.data.i7: Voice recordings, transcripts and clinical drafts only when the corresponding features are enabled and used.
legal.privacy.data.i8: Support requests, complaints, consents, objections and related evidence.
legal.privacy.purposes.title: 4. Purposes and legal grounds
legal.privacy.purposes.i1: Identify patients, support continuity of care, provide access to records and coordinate authorised professionals.
legal.privacy.purposes.i2: Manage appointments, admissions, hospital stays, prescriptions, examinations, documents, invoices and payments.
legal.privacy.purposes.i3: Authenticate users, manage permissions, prevent fraudulent access and ensure traceability.
legal.privacy.purposes.i4: Provide support, handle incidents, improve service reliability and meet contractual obligations.
legal.privacy.purposes.i5: Meet applicable legal, regulatory, healthcare, accounting, evidentiary and security obligations.
legal.privacy.purposes.i6: Produce, where authorised, aggregated or anonymised statistics that do not directly identify individuals.
legal.privacy.purposes.p1: Depending on the situation, processing may rely on healthcare provision, performance of a contract, a legal obligation, protection of vital interests, valid consent or a legitimate interest compatible with the person’s rights.
legal.privacy.sharing.title: 5. Recipients and sharing
legal.privacy.sharing.p1: Data is accessible only to persons whose duties and permissions justify access. JOPRELYS SARL does not sell personal or medical data.
legal.privacy.sharing.i1: Authorised healthcare professionals and administrative staff of the healthcare facility.
legal.privacy.sharing.i2: The patient, legal representative or expressly authorised person, subject to applicable rules.
legal.privacy.sharing.i3: Strictly necessary technical providers bound by confidentiality and security obligations.
legal.privacy.sharing.i4: Authorised public bodies or organisations where required by law, a decision or an emergency.
legal.privacy.hosting.title: 6. Hosting and transfers
legal.privacy.hosting.p1: Joprelys Connect production data is intended to be hosted on infrastructure located in Cameroon. The hosting provider’s exact identity and address must be added to the legal notice before final publication.
legal.privacy.hosting.p2: Any transfer outside Cameroon, if later required, must first be assessed, contractually governed, disclosed to the persons concerned and carried out in accordance with the applicable authorisations and safeguards.
legal.privacy.security.title: 7. Security and confidentiality
legal.privacy.security.p1: JOPRELYS SARL and user facilities implement technical and organisational measures proportionate to the risks associated with health data.
legal.privacy.security.i1: Access control by account, role and permission, with stronger authentication where necessary.
legal.privacy.security.i2: Encrypted communications, secure session management, backups and incident monitoring.
legal.privacy.security.i3: Logging of access and sensitive actions, facility separation and least-privilege access.
legal.privacy.security.i4: Incident response, vulnerability remediation, continuity and restoration procedures.
legal.privacy.rights.title: 8. Individual rights
legal.privacy.rights.p1: Subject to medical, legal and evidentiary obligations, every person may exercise the rights recognised under Cameroonian law.
legal.privacy.rights.i1: The right to be informed and obtain access to personal data.
legal.privacy.rights.i2: The right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
legal.privacy.rights.i3: The right to request erasure, restriction or cessation of disclosure where legal conditions are met.
legal.privacy.rights.i4: The right to object and, where applicable, the right to data portability.
legal.privacy.rights.i5: The right to submit a complaint to JOPRELYS SARL, the relevant facility or the competent authority.
legal.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.terms.summary: These terms define the rules governing access to and use of Joprelys Connect by professionals, facilities and patients in Cameroon.
legal.terms.purpose.title: 1. Purpose and acceptance
legal.terms.purpose.p1: Joprelys Connect is a digital platform for managing and coordinating healthcare journeys. It provides tools to facilities, professionals and patients according to the enabled modules.
legal.terms.purpose.p2: Accessing or using the service means accepting these terms, the rules of the relevant facility and the applicable privacy and security policies.
legal.terms.access.title: 2. Access and accounts
legal.terms.access.i1: Each account is personal. Login details, passwords and security codes must not be shared.
legal.terms.access.i2: The user provides accurate information and keeps contact details up to date.
legal.terms.access.i3: Any suspected unauthorised access must be reported immediately to support or security.
legal.terms.access.i4: Access rights are assigned according to role, facility, permissions and care needs.
legal.terms.professional.title: 3. Professional obligations
legal.terms.professional.i1: Comply with professional secrecy, confidentiality and applicable ethical rules.
legal.terms.professional.i2: Access only records required for professional duties and never use data for personal purposes.
legal.terms.professional.i3: Enter accurate, dated, useful and proportionate information for patient care.
legal.terms.professional.i4: Review and validate every prescription, decision or proposal produced with the assistance of a digital or artificial intelligence tool.
legal.terms.professional.i5: Report errors, incidents, duplicates, abusive access or outages that may affect patient safety.
legal.terms.patient.title: 4. Patient obligations
legal.terms.patient.i1: Provide accurate identity and health information to the extent necessary for care.
legal.terms.patient.i2: Protect access credentials and prevent unauthorised third parties from using the account.
legal.terms.patient.i3: Use sharing functions carefully and verify the recipient’s identity.
legal.terms.patient.i4: Promptly report an error in the record or an unrecognised access.
legal.terms.medical.title: 5. Medical limitations
legal.terms.medical.p1: Joprelys Connect is an assistance and coordination tool. It does not replace a clinical examination, the judgement of a healthcare professional or emergency services.
legal.terms.medical.p2: In a life-threatening emergency or when in doubt about a health condition, the user must immediately contact an appropriate healthcare professional or emergency service.
legal.terms.prohibited.title: 6. Prohibited uses
legal.terms.prohibited.i1: Access a record without authorisation, bypass a permission or impersonate another user.
legal.terms.prohibited.i2: Extract, copy, photograph, publish or transmit confidential data without a legitimate reason and authorisation.
legal.terms.prohibited.i3: Introduce malware, disrupt the service, test a vulnerability without authorisation or automate abusive access.
legal.terms.prohibited.i4: Use the platform to forge a document, divert a payment or commit fraud.
legal.terms.prohibited.i5: Use health data for discrimination, unauthorised marketing or illegitimate surveillance.
legal.terms.availability.title: 7. Availability and maintenance
legal.terms.availability.p1: JOPRELYS SARL uses reasonable means to ensure service availability, security, maintenance and recovery. Some interruptions may nevertheless be necessary or caused by external events.
legal.terms.availability.p2: Facilities must maintain continuity procedures that enable healthcare delivery when the platform or network is temporarily unavailable.
legal.terms.responsibility.title: 8. Responsibilities
legal.terms.responsibility.p1: Each facility remains responsible for organising care, making medical decisions, managing internal permissions, ensuring data quality and supervising use by its staff.
legal.terms.responsibility.p2: JOPRELYS SARL is responsible for its contractual and technical obligations within the limits permitted by law and contract. No clause limits liability that cannot legally be excluded.
legal.terms.law.title: 9. Applicable law and disputes
legal.terms.law.p1: These terms are governed by Cameroonian law. The service is intended for use in Cameroon.
legal.terms.law.p2: In the event of a dispute, the parties first seek an amicable solution. Failing this, the dispute falls within the jurisdiction of the competent Cameroonian courts, subject to mandatory rules.

legal.notice.ip.p2: No reproduction, extraction, adaptation, distribution or exploitation is permitted without a right, licence or prior written authorisation, except where allowed by law.
legal.notice.liability.title: 5. Information and links

legal.cookies.title: Cookie and tracking policy
legal.cookies.summary: This page describes the cookies, local storage and technical mechanisms used to operate and secure Joprelys Connect.
legal.cookies.principle.title: 1. Principle
legal.cookies.principle.p1: A cookie or local storage item is information saved on a user’s device to maintain a session, remember a preference or protect the service.
legal.cookies.principle.p2: In its current configuration, Joprelys Connect does not use advertising cookies, commercial profiling or the sale of browsing data.
legal.cookies.necessary.title: 2. Strictly necessary technologies
legal.cookies.necessary.i1: Session and security cookies required for authentication, token rotation and prevention of fraudulent access.
legal.cookies.necessary.i2: Temporary information required for the patient portal and professional workspaces.
legal.cookies.necessary.i3: Mechanisms protecting against unauthorised requests and maintaining session integrity.
legal.cookies.necessary.i4: Server-side technical logs required for security, diagnostics and traceability.
legal.cookies.storage.title: 3. Browser storage
legal.cookies.storage.p1: The platform may use local or session storage to remember non-sensitive preferences and secure the user experience.
legal.cookies.storage.i3: Temporary technical elements related to the session, permissions or navigation state, deleted on logout or expiry according to their nature.
legal.cookies.choices.title: 4. User choices
legal.cookies.choices.p1: The browser allows cookies and local storage to be deleted or blocked. Blocking strictly necessary technologies may prevent sign-in or make some functions unavailable.
legal.cookies.choices.p2: If analytics, telemedicine tools or non-essential trackers are later added, this policy and, where required, the consent mechanism will be updated before activation.
legal.health.title: Health data protection policy
legal.health.summary: Specific commitments applying to medical records, consultations, prescriptions, results and other sensitive information processed by Joprelys Connect.
legal.health.sensitive.title: 1. Sensitive nature of health data
legal.health.sensitive.p1: Health information is sensitive data. Its collection, access, use and sharing require a legitimate purpose, appropriate permissions and enhanced confidentiality measures.
legal.health.sensitive.p2: JOPRELYS SARL does not claim ownership of a patient’s medical record and does not use it for advertising purposes.
legal.health.responsibilities.title: 2. Respective responsibilities
legal.health.responsibilities.i1: The facility organises care, determines staff access and remains responsible for medical decisions.
legal.health.responsibilities.i2: JOPRELYS SARL provides the software infrastructure, follows contractual instructions, protects the platform and performs support and traceability functions.
legal.health.responsibilities.i3: The professional remains responsible for the relevance, accuracy and validation of information entered or approved.
legal.health.access.title: 3. Access, secrecy and traceability
legal.health.access.i1: Access is restricted according to role, permissions, facility, care relationship and applicable rules.
legal.health.access.i2: Access and sensitive actions may be logged with the user, date, purpose and context.
legal.health.access.i3: Abusive access may result in account suspension, internal investigation, disciplinary measures, notification to the facility and legal proceedings.
legal.health.access.i4: Users must protect the confidentiality of screens, documents and any export or printout.
legal.health.sharing.title: 4. Sharing and interoperability
legal.health.sharing.p1: Sharing between facilities, professionals, laboratories, pharmacies or other parties must occur only for care, a legal obligation or valid authorisation, with the required information and controls.
legal.health.sharing.p2: Interconnection of sensitive files and processing operations requiring authorisation must be activated only after the applicable regulatory formalities have been completed.
legal.health.emergency.title: 5. Emergency access
legal.health.emergency.p1: Emergency access may be provided where necessary to protect life or deliver urgent care. It must be limited, justified, logged and reviewed afterwards in accordance with facility rules and the law.
legal.health.ai.title: 6. Artificial intelligence, voice and clinical drafts
legal.health.ai.p1: An artificial intelligence feature does not make autonomous medical decisions and never replaces validation by a qualified professional.
legal.health.ai.p2: When a voice recording or transcript is used, the user must be informed of the purpose, retention period, recipients and technical provider before production activation.
legal.health.ai.p3: Drafts, summaries and suggestions must be reviewed, corrected and validated. Data must not be used to train a third-party model without a legal basis, appropriate information and contractual safeguards.
legal.health.incidents.title: 7. Incidents and reporting
legal.health.incidents.p1: Any lost device, disclosure, unusual access, incorrect recipient, unauthorised screenshot or publication must be reported immediately so that the impact can be limited and appropriate procedures started.
legal.retention.title: Data retention and deletion policy
legal.retention.summary: Principles and indicative retention schedule for data processed by Joprelys Connect, subject to applicable healthcare, accounting and evidentiary obligations.
legal.retention.principle.title: 1. Limited retention principle
legal.retention.principle.p1: Data is retained for a period proportionate to its purpose, facility obligations, legal requirements and the defence of rights. It is then deleted, anonymised or securely archived.
legal.retention.principle.p2: The schedule below is an internal proposal requiring validation with facilities and legal counsel before final publication. It does not replace specific medical-record retention rules.
legal.retention.schedule.title: 2. Indicative schedule
legal.retention.schedule.i1: Medical records and care documents: for the period determined by the facility in accordance with applicable medical, healthcare, ethical and evidentiary obligations.
legal.retention.schedule.i2: Professional or patient account: for the active life of the account and up to twelve months after closure to complete security, support and dispute handling, unless a longer obligation applies.
legal.retention.schedule.i3: Login and session logs: up to twelve months, unless an incident, investigation or obligation requires a different period.
legal.retention.schedule.i4: Audit logs relating to health-data access: up to five years as a proposed security policy, subject to regulatory and contractual validation.
legal.retention.schedule.i5: Support tickets and complaints: up to three years after closure, unless litigation is pending.
legal.retention.schedule.i6: Contractual, accounting and invoice data: for the period required by applicable accounting, tax and commercial obligations, generally up to ten years where required.
legal.retention.schedule.i7: Technical backups: target maximum rotation of ninety days, except for an isolated backup required for an incident, restoration or legal obligation.
legal.retention.deletion.title: 3. Deletion, correction and archiving
legal.retention.deletion.p1: An erasure request does not automatically result in deletion of medical information where retention remains necessary for continuity of care, a legal obligation, evidence or the defence of a right.
legal.retention.deletion.p2: Incorrect clinical data may need to be corrected or supplemented while retaining an audit trail, rather than deleted without history.
legal.retention.backup.title: 4. Backups and contract termination
legal.retention.backup.p1: At the end of a contract, return, export, portability, archiving and destruction procedures are arranged with the facility. Residual backup copies are deleted according to their rotation cycle, unless retention is required.
legal.rights.title: Exercise your rights
legal.rights.summary: Procedure for requesting access, correction, restriction, objection, erasure or portability of personal data processed in Joprelys Connect.
legal.rights.list.title: 1. Available rights
legal.rights.list.i1: Receive clear information about how your data is used.
legal.rights.list.i2: Request access to personal data and, where applicable, receive a copy.
legal.rights.list.i3: Correct inaccurate information or complete incomplete data.
legal.rights.list.i4: Request restriction, objection or erasure where legal conditions are met.
legal.rights.list.i5: Request cessation of disclosure or data portability where these rights apply.
legal.rights.list.i6: Submit a complaint and request an explanation about disputed access or a decision.
legal.rights.who.title: 2. Where should the request be sent?
legal.rights.who.p1: For information related to care, the content of a medical record, a prescription or a facility decision, the request should first be sent to the clinic or healthcare facility providing care.
legal.rights.who.p2: For Joprelys accounts, security, support, technical logs or processing carried out by JOPRELYS SARL for its own purposes, the request may be sent directly to the contacts below.
legal.rights.request.title: 3. Request contents
legal.rights.request.p1: The request must identify the person and the right being exercised precisely, without submitting more information than necessary.
legal.rights.request.i1: First name, surname and a reliable contact method.
legal.rights.request.i2: Relevant facility and, where available, patient number or account identifier.
legal.rights.request.i3: Right exercised and a precise description of the data or period concerned.
legal.rights.request.i4: Any useful information needed to understand the request or disputed access.
legal.rights.verification.title: 4. Verification and response
legal.rights.verification.p1: To avoid disclosure to a third party, proportionate verification of identity or authority may be requested. A full identity-document copy should be required only where necessary and must be protected.
legal.rights.verification.p2: The request is handled within the periods provided by applicable law. A restriction or refusal must be explained where a medical, legal, security or evidentiary obligation prevents full compliance.
legal.rights.complaint.title: 5. Complaint and competent authority
legal.rights.complaint.p1: If the response is unsatisfactory, the person may request reconsideration, use the complaints address, contact the relevant facility and, where the conditions are met, complain to the competent Cameroonian authority or courts.
